scope: Frozen camera geometry, actual production render, existing inert Canvas boundary fixture, current-thread CPU timing; real Canvas/PNG encoding, browser/RPC/GPU excluded.

baselineFrozenModule.description: Frozen module with pre-optimization finiteVolume hot loop; the shared material, mask and geometry definitions match the optimized snapshot.

optimizedFrozenModule.description: Frozen optimized module before the later identity-exposure and 4px-rim visual calibration.

cameraGeometrySnapshot.description: Identical carrier-flight geometry used by both implementations, after beamReach completion was moved to 1100ms.

productionAfterVisualCalibration.description: Same optimized beam loop; subsequently advances identity exposure and extends only the optical rim by four final-DOM pixels.

benchmarkHarness.description: Temporary harness reusing scripts/check-carrier-optics.mjs Canvas boundary fixture.

method.clock: process.threadCpuUsage for current-thread CPU; performance.now for wall time
method.warmup: One full presentation for each implementation before the measured paired comparison.
method.sourceGeometry: Fixed world-space rectangular aperture and carrier outline projected by the production carrierCamera/projectOpticalPoint for every sample.
method.comparison: Both implementations receive the same frozen per-frame inputs. Every available volume buffer is compared byte-for-byte, including transparent pixels.
included: SHA256 placeholder instead of PNG mask encoding
excluded: Real Canvas rasterization and actual putImageData backend
limitations: This is a local CPU benchmark, not browser FPS or GPU acceptance.
The equivalence result covers the beam raster; it does not claim the subsequent intentional mask/rim visual changes are unchanged.
Single measured warmed traversal per viewport; peaks include allocation/GC and runtime effects.
